summary: Mike Lemaire is a French-born fighter and coach known as “The French Rock.” He started judo at four, added karate and kickboxing at 12, and built his Muay Thai career after moving to San Diego. He won the WBC and WCK Muay Thai world titles and the 2013 Road to GLORY tournament, which earned him a GLORY Kickboxing contract. Today he is head coach of the Victory MMA fight team in San Diego and founder of Fitness Mike Lemaire, where his Biological Recode System™ helps busy men get lean and strong. On stage he speaks on discipline, resilience and performing at your best after 40, and runs hands-on self-defense workshops.
